A '''Zabrak Jedi General''' was a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]]. When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] took up a role as a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] in command of the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone soldiers]] that made up the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. While leading [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in [[Battle of Malsuum|battle]] on a [[Malsuum|desert world]], the Jedi [[General/Legends|General's]] [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] came under [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|enemy]] [[Blaster/Legends|fire]]. During the attack, a [[Hock Malsuum|clone trooper]] was struck and fell from the gunship's open crew bay; the Zabrak General made no move to rescue the wounded trooper, who was abandoned for [[Death/Legends|dead]] after the battle and left to fend for himself in the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] expanse. Because of the General's inaction, the clone soldier developed a hatred for the Jedi he had once served which remained for years after.<ref name="DVaCoS1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Zabrak Jedi General first appeared in ''[[Star Wars]]'' in the [[Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series ''[[Star Wars: Darth Vader and the Cry of Shadows]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Tim Siedell]] and published [[December 18]], [[2012]].
